prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: continuous 3:1 wide scroll background for a toddler educational supermarket game. Scene: a welcoming small grocery store seen at a child's human eye level, perspective straight across the front of a long low wooden display counter. Warm daylight, clean pale mint shelves, honey-colored wood and subtle cream floor tiles, illustrated dimensional 3D storybook painterly style with crisp forms, not photorealistic. A continuous flat counter top runs horizontally at 70 percent of image height, clear upper shelves and plenty of open lower aisle floor below the counter; small shelf decor such as colored unlabelled boxes may sit far in the background but foreground countertop is EMPTY, reserved for separate clickable groceries. No people, no faces, no mascots, no signs, no letters, no numbers, no brands, no UI. Long very wide 3:1 panorama, quiet airy generous composition, sharp detailed edges, no artificial depth of field blur. Edges should blend in natural softly repeating interior color and the counter's horizontal height must match across left and right edges. Do not paint large milk, bread, eggs, yogurt, tissues, shopping cart, or basket into the background, because those will be independent sprites.
